name: MCP Sentinel
description: Enterprise governance layer for AI-agent access to Drupal over MCP/JSON:API/GraphQL — policy profiles, per-surface egress ceilings, field redaction, DLP, finite read budgets, tamper-evident audit logging (audit_chain), portable attested policy bundles, sealed-manifest human approval, and reliable webhooks. A security-positive control plane built on Key, encrypt, simple_oauth, consumers.

suggests.drupal/mcp_server: Exposes MCP Sentinel Tool plugins to MCP clients (via the mcp_sentinel_server submodule). Strongly recommended.
suggests.drupal/graphql_compose: Enables the mcp_sentinel_graphql submodule: mutation gating, field redaction, and audit for the GraphQL endpoint.
suggests.drupal/mcp_tools: Adds 222 site-building tools (across 34 optional submodules) via the Tool API; MCP Sentinel governs them.
suggests.drupal/charts: Optional: upgrades the governance-dashboard inline-SVG charts to interactive, exportable charts. The dashboard works without it.
